formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiCF3SO3 system. Intermediate compound stoichiometry debated (3.5:1 vs 4:1). Eutectic composition approximated at O/Li ~100.
formulations.Notes: Salt mass fractions ranged from 0.11 to 0.47. Activation energy constant at ~0.7 eV for T > 60C. Intermediate compound stoichiometry appears to be less than 4 (approx 3.5).
formulations.Reference: Robitaille, C. D., & Fauteux, D. (1986). Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Characterization of Some PEO-LiX Electrolytes. J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315-325.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiClO4 system. Intermediate compounds P(EO3LiClO4) and P(EO6LiClO4) formed. Monotectic behavior observed.
formulations.Notes: Salt mass fractions ranged from 0.11 to 0.45. Activation energy ~0.7 eV for high concentrations, ~0.3 eV for diluted. Conductivity maximum at X ~ 0.18 (O/Li ~ 12).
formulations.Reference: Robitaille, C. D., & Fauteux, D. (1986). Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Characterization of Some PEO-LiX Electrolytes. J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315-325.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiAsF6 system. Intermediate compounds P(EO3LiAsF6) and P(EO6LiAsF6) formed. Isomorphous with P(EO6LiClO4).
formulations.Notes: Salt mass fractions ranged from 0.04 to 0.36. Electrolytes with X > 0.35 were thermally unstable (blackening, conductivity increase). Activation energy ~0.6-0.7 eV. Conductivity maximum at X ~ 0.18.
formulations.Reference: Robitaille, C. D., & Fauteux, D. (1986). Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Characterization of Some PEO-LiX Electrolytes. J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315-325.
